shots.desc: The reference frame recreated: player low-left, boss crowned by moon, wings full width.
Wing translucency, moss detail, eye bloom at close range.
Hat silhouette, straw fringe, blade highlight, waterline ripples.
Fog hides the world limits; both frame edges framed by architecture.
